findings.uncertainty: Do not treat approximate crowded rectangles as exact masks.

findings.conclusion: Fixed context supports one bent lower-right animal, split into audit G/H, and an additional white-backed foreground-left body omitted by audit review. Cattle separation is better supported.

findings.conclusion: Both reviewers retained tiny upper-border possible animal fragments and marked presence uncertain. No identity or definite extra-animal count is inferred.

interpretation: High median rectangle overlap does not establish accurate instance counts or biological identities. Both reviews are AI-assisted, with prior general scene exposure. Their markedly different uncertainty rates are a policy-interpretation difference, not evidence that one observer is objectively more accurate.
